shortDescription: Clearwater Paper Corporation NYSE:CLW announced the completion of a comprehensive debt refinancing, replacing its existing 2028 senior notes, term revolver, and asset-backed lending (ABL) revolving credit facilities with a new five-year financing package maturing on September 18, 2031.Under the ame…

params.linkText: completion of a comprehensive debt refinancing

children: , replacing its existing 2028 senior notes, term revolver, and asset-backed lending (ABL) revolving credit facilities with a new five-year financing package maturing on September 18, 2031.

Under the amended and restated agreement with AgWest Farm Credit, PCA, and a lender syndicate, the new structure includes: a $275M term loan facility, which was fully drawn at closing to redeem Clearwater Paper's $275M in outstanding 2028 senior notes.
It also includes a $200M revolving credit facility, closed with roughly $15M drawn to replace and terminate the company's previous ABL facility.

Additionally, Clearwater Paper holds a $100M uncommitted option to expand its revolving capacity, subject to lender participation, delivery of 2027 year-end financial statements, and standard closing conditions.

Borrowings under the new credit agreement were used to pay off and terminate the existing ABL credit facility and satisfy the redemption price to redeem Clearwater Paper’s outstanding $275M senior notes due 2028 in full.

title: Clearwater Paper refinances debt profile with new five-year credit agreement
